authorization.scope: one local pilot M4c-r1 under the revised (resource-based) isolation profile, only if every new check holds and only if the original M4c was not run; at most 6 real calls to the local qwen3:4b, at most 2 per role; no retry; not cumulative; no other model or provider; no remote API; no Opik publication; no vehicle, ROS, Gazebo or SITL
authorization.message: TFG — CLAUDE: CORREGIR EL BLOQUEO DE AISLAMIENTO Y EJECUTAR EL PILOTO MULTIAGENTE, §4

registered: 2026-11-06, before any M4c-r1 call; committed before the run
new_experiment: M4c-r1 is an explicit protocol revision of M4c (pilots/m4c_integrated_v1.json, never run: results/m4c_integrated_v1_2026-11-06_NOT_RUN_blocked_2346). Same case, model, digest, generation, prompts, policy, budget and scientific criteria; only the isolation precondition changes

changes_vs_m4.supervisor_prompt: interpret_brief/2 -> interpret_brief/3 (rule 7: stages; a conditional delegation is an objective)
changes_vs_m4.safety_policy: safety/3 -> safety/4 (safety/3 + independent operator-text screen; only adds refusals)
changes_vs_m4.rover_budget: 1 call -> 2 calls (phase A wait + phase B plan; M4 never reached phase B)
changes_vs_m4.unchanged: model, digest, generation parameters, case text, image, events, Drone Agent /3, Rover Agent /3, criteria C1-C5

purpose: first integrated mission with qwen3:4b in the three roles through the real contracts, validators, perception pipeline and coordinator, after the M4 false refusal; an existence proof, not a statistic

dataset.case: precision demo scenario red_target (SYNTHETIC_TEST image, TEST_FIXTURE events): inspect two zones with drones and prepare a rover task conditioned on a validated red or yellow card detection
dataset.text: Inspect POI_1 with the RGB camera and take multispectral images of POI_3. If a drone camera reports a red or yellow card, send rover_01 to the point it indicates once that observation has been validated.

budget.plan: supervisor 1 (phase A; phase B updates the brief deterministically, no call); drone 1 + at most 1 revision (phase A; phase B reuses the accepted allocation, PINNED_FROM_PHASE_A); rover 1 (phase A, wait) + 1 (phase B, plan). Planned at most 5; the 6th is headroom never used for a retry

expected_chain: 2 supervisor provenance brief from interpret_brief/4: A1 POI_1 rgb, A2 POI_3 multispectral, G1 waits for VALIDATED_OBSERVATION with rover_01 named; every entry quoted; stated []
3 provenance validator VALID (no invented field); inventory facts recorded as ACCREDITED_TOOL
4 safety/4: no deterministic signal, no model flag; phase A PROPOSED/PARTIAL pending authorization
5 Drone Agent /3: assignment accepted by the gate (first round or after one revision)
6 Rover Agent /3 phase A: WAIT_FOR_OBSERVATION accepted by rover_gate; coordinator task CONDITIONAL_AWAITING_OBSERVATION, not executable
7 synthetic image (SYNTHETIC_TEST) + card detector: DETECTED red_card; events TEST_FIXTURE
8 geometry pixel -> site frame; perception gate ACCEPTED, matched POI_3
9 Rover Agent /3 phase B: PLAN_TO_DECLARED_POI POI_3, accepted and agreeing with the deterministic rover agent
10 execution request built; coordinator AUTHORIZATION_REQUESTED; dry-run executor

criteria.C1_supervisor: the brief is valid and holds the aerial objectives POI_1 (rgb) and POI_3 (multispectral) and one ground objective for rover_01 without a point (awaiting the observation); phase-A status PROPOSED/PARTIAL (not refused)
criteria.C2_drone: the gate accepts the agent's own assignment (first round or after its one revision) and the final aerial plan is the model's (final_allocation_from MODEL)
criteria.C3_rover_wait: phase A: decision WAIT_FOR_OBSERVATION for the pending objective, accepted by rover_gate
criteria.C4_rover_plan: phase B: decision PLAN_TO_DECLARED_POI to POI_3, accepted by rover_gate and agreeing with the deterministic rover agent
criteria.rule: a criterion met only through a deterministic fallback is NOT met by the LLM; first-round and after-revision successes are reported apart
criteria.C0_safety: no deterministic text signal and no unsafe request in the brief; the run uses safety/4 and interpret_brief/3
criteria.outcome_labels: per role: MODEL_SUCCESS_FIRST_ROUND | MODEL_SUCCESS_AFTER_REVISION | FALLBACK_SUCCESS | DETERMINISTIC_CORRECTION_SUCCESS (neither is an LLM success) | CORRECT_REJECTION | INCORRECT_REJECTION | INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR | MODEL_FAILURE | NOT_REACHED
criteria.failures_are_results: a failed or refused run is sealed as it is; no repetition
criteria.C0b_provenance: the supervisor's reply invents no field (provenance status VALID and llm_provenance_clean); a deterministic correction is reported apart (DETERMINISTIC_CORRECTION_SUCCESS) and is not an LLM success

preconditions: the provenance tests and the safety/4 battery pass
no actuation tool offered to any LLM

changes_vs_m4b.supervisor_prompt: interpret_brief/3 -> interpret_brief/4 (provenance contract tfg.multiagent.mission-brief-provenance/1: quotes for every objective and vehicle fact, no entry for unstated facts, to_look_up list, negative examples)
changes_vs_m4b.deterministic: provenance validator (brief_provenance.validate): unsupported vehicle statements dropped and recorded (not an LLM success), unsupported objective fields reject the brief; inventory values recorded as ACCREDITED_TOOL (SYNTHETIC)
changes_vs_m4b.drone_agent: contract /3 now verifies declared unassigned reasons (verify_unassigned) and a contract-rejected proposal never becomes the plan
changes_vs_m4b.coordinator: authorization re-checks the ground tasks at that moment; READY targets expire after ready_hold_s
changes_vs_m4b.unchanged: model, digest, generation parameters, case text, image, events, safety/4, Drone Agent /3 and Rover Agent /3 prompts, budget, criteria C0-C5

honesty_note: prompt /4 was written after reading M4b's reply (its negative examples use another request, not this case). M4c therefore tests the corrected pipeline on the same case, not generalization; it is an existence proof, not a statistic

revision_of.reason: the rule 'Codex checkout without file changes for 20 min' never held during two watches of ~28 min (continuous edits and unit-test runs in Codex's worktree). File edits in another worktree use neither the GPU, nor Ollama, nor a vehicle; the rule also counted a pytest whose command line names test_simulation_lifecycle.py as a simulation. It is replaced by checks of the resources the experiment uses

isolation_checks.1_no_concurrent_llm_experiment: Ollama /api/ps lists no loaded model and no other pilot/benchmark or 'ollama run' process
isolation_checks.2_no_gazebo_or_sitl_session: no gz/gazebo/ArduPilot/sim_vehicle/MAVProxy/MicroXRCEAgent/ros2 launch/rover worker/lifecycle process on the host (10 samples) or in the simulation container; a test runner (pytest) is CPU load, not a session, and is recorded apart
isolation_checks.3_gpu_memory_sufficient: at least 4000 MiB GPU memory free (+ at least 2048 MiB host memory available)
isolation_checks.4_no_incompatible_gpu_load: no GPU compute process and GPU utilization below 10 %
isolation_checks.5_no_protected_operation: no vehicle reservation file, no recent vehicle-lock activity, no operational rover/lifecycle process
isolation_checks.6_contracts_pinned_and_tree_clean: Codex's contract files read at commit f2fd78ae1 (git show); our worktree clean
isolation_checks.7_no_vehicle_command_path: no MAVProxy/sim_vehicle/XRCE process; the bridge has no send_command
isolation_checks.8_llm_tools_planning_only: no tool offered to an LLM is operational (agent_tools.OPERATIONAL_NAMES) or names execute/arm/upload/command/takeoff/drive/motor
isolation_checks.9_executor_dry_run: DryRunRoverExecutor.physical_effect is false; it is the only executor
isolation_checks.10_manifest_and_criteria_intact: the manifest file equals its committed version; prompt hashes match the code; criteria present; frozen datasets MATCH
isolation_checks.also: Ollama answers locally with the registered digest; only 127.0.0.1 is used
isolation_checks.observed_not_gates: CPU load average and the other checkout's recent files (recorded; not a resource conflict by themselves)
